Spells:
Air Walk (Wind4 Tran): Touched can walk on air for 200 min, then floats downward 60' per rd for 1d6 rd; winds of over 20 MPH push the target 5' per 5 MPH; training a mount to Air Walk requires a week of work and a DC 25 Handle Animal check
Arcane Lock (Wards1 Abju): Increases by 10 the DC for others to open a touched door, portal, or chest or creates a DC 20 lock on an object without one
Control Winds (Wind5 Tran): R800' Changes the wind direction and speed by 6 levels in a 800'x40' cylinder for 200 min (save Fortitude each rd negates wind effects on a creature for 1 rd)
Dimensional Anchor (Wards4 Abju): R300' Ranged touch attack bars extradimensional travel for 20 min
Elemental Body IV (Wind7 Tran): Self becomes a Huge elemental for 20 min—a choice of air (gives +4 Strength; +6 Dexterity, a +4 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, a 120' fly Speed, and the ability to create a whirlwind), earth (gives +8 Strength, -2 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, a +6 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, and the ability to earth glide), fire (gives +6 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, a +4 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, resistance 20 to fire, vulnerability to cold, and the ability to burn), or water (gives +4 Strength, -2 Dexterity, +8 Constitution, a +6 natural armor bonus to Armor Class, a 60' swim Speed, the ability to create a vortex, and the ability to breathe water); all forms also give 60' Darkvision, immunity to bleed damage, critical hits, and Sneak Attack, and DR 5/-
Gaseous Form (Wind3 Tran): Touched becomes insubstantial, losing its armor bonus to Armor Class, any supernatural abilities, ability to manipulate objects, and ability to cast spells with components, but gaining DR 10/magic, immunity to poison, Sneak Attack, and critical hits, a 10' fly Speed, and the ability to pass through small openings, for 40 min
Glyph Of Warding (Wards3 Abju): Creatures with specified characteristics who enter a 100 square foot area trigger a blast that inflicts 5d8 HP of a choice of acid, cold, fire, electricity, or sonic in a 5' radius (save Reflex half; password negates) or a harmful spell of up to 3rd level
Guards And Wards (Wards6 Abju): Multiple magic effects protect a 4000' sq area for 40 hr
Instant Summons (Wards7 Conj): Prepares an item weighing up to 10 lb and up to 6' long to teleport to self when desired; if the item is held when summoned, the spell instead reveals the possessor
Lesser Planar Binding (Wards5 Conj): Traps an extraplanar creature with up to 6 HD in a Magic Circle (save Will negates) until it performs a task (opposed Charisma allows refusal), or escapes via SR, dimensional travel, or a DC 27 Charisma check
Secret Page (Wards2 Tran): Permanently alters the text on a touched page so that a password is required to read the original
Symbol Of Death (Wards8 Necr): Rune slays creatures in a 60' radius (save Fortitude negates) when triggered, working outward from the closest creatures, for 200 min or until creatures with 150 HP total have been killed
Teleportation Circle (Wards9 Conj): 5' radius transports creatures any distance with no chance of error for 200 min
Whirlwind (Wind8 Evoc): R1200' 10' radius, 30' high cyclone moves 60' as directed each rd, inflicting 3d6 HP on Large and smaller creatures (save Reflex negates), for 20 rd; it traps Medium and smaller creatures (save Reflex negates), inflicting an additional 1d8 HP on each subsequent rd
Whispering Wind (Wind1 Tran): R20 miles Allows sending a whispered 25-word message or sound to a familiar 10' area
Wind Walk (Wind6 Tran): Allows self and 6 touched (save Will negates) to spend 5 rd changing to and from a translucent vapor that can move 60 MPH, for 20 hr
Wind Wall (Wind2 Evoc): R300' Creates a 200'x100'x2' curtain of air that scatters objects, bars gasses and Small or smaller flying creatures, and deflects arrows and bolts for 20 rd
Winds Of Vengeance (Wind9 Evoc): Self gains 60' fly and immunity to wind, gas, and ranged weapons; inflicts on attackers 5d8 HP bludgeoning and knocked prone (Fortitude half HP only), for 20 min
